alignment.primary: EU AI Act Annex VII (technical documentation + post-market monitoring readiness)
alignment.notes: This file is a self-assessment artifact for operator readiness. It does not constitute conformity assessment, certification, or legal advice.

document_control.title: Access PoD — EU AI Act Annex VII Evidence Readiness Self-Assessment

owner.organization: Alnotrea Labs / Policy of Developments - Access PoD Initiative

confidentiality.restriction_note: Cryptographic realization, validation node internals, thresholds, and incident playbooks are governed by restricted specifications and are intentionally excluded.

system_profile.intended_purpose: Reference implementation used to demonstrate runtime governance instantiation under Access PoD and CSC.

deployment_context.scope_statement: This artifact supports standards exploration and does not assert regulatory compliance or high-risk classification.

response_scale.notes: Operators should attach references to evidence artifacts in the evidence_manifest section or in the separate apod_governance_evidence_manifest.json.

items.requirement: Intended purpose and deployment scope are defined and versioned.
items.notes: Define production vs pilot scope and sector profile declarations.

items.requirement: Governance authority (Access PoD) is separated from execution capability.
items.notes: Separation-of-powers is enforced through proposal/authorization workflow.

items.requirement: Roles and responsibilities (operator, deployer, suppliers) are documented.
items.notes: Add supplier/third-party delegation clauses for external model APIs (if enabled).

items.requirement: Scope changes trigger governance review.
items.notes: Formalize scope-change gates and record as governance telemetry.

items.requirement: Continuous risk management exists (not only pre-deployment).
items.notes: Demonstrate post-market risk review cadence with runtime telemetry inputs.

items.requirement: High-risk changes trigger simulation-based evaluation (SAPP).
items.notes: Retain simulation summaries and sign-off records.

items.requirement: Risk categories are identified and reviewed (safety, misuse, systemic impact).
items.notes: Expand risk taxonomy per sector profiles when applicable.

items.requirement: Risk mitigation decisions are traceable to governance actions.
items.notes: Ensure consistent linkage from risk items to enforcement points.

items.requirement: Data procurement and updates are controlled through governance workflows.
items.notes: Execution APIs do not independently approve training data.

items.requirement: Provenance/lineage is tracked across lifecycle phases (UGCCMT semantics).
items.notes: Cryptographic realization is restricted; semantic lineage summaries are available.

items.requirement: Data updates/extensions are attributable and auditable.
items.notes: Ensure consistent unit/group mapping and change records.

items.requirement: Data governance applies across major modalities in scope.
items.notes: Majority modality coverage documented; minority modalities optional.

items.requirement: Policies are executable (policy-as-code) with enforceable control points.
items.notes: Demonstrate enforcement point registry and audit trail.

items.requirement: Telemetry is attributable to enforcement points and persists across updates.
items.notes: Add telemetry completeness metrics and freshness reporting.

items.requirement: Human-in-the-loop oversight exists for elevated-risk events.
items.notes: Ensure escalation criteria are explicit and auditable.

items.requirement: Human interventions and overrides are logged as governance evidence.
items.notes: Standardize intervention logging fields and timestamps.

items.requirement: Controls monitor for drift/misuse/control degradation.
items.notes: Drift thresholds are restricted; provide high-level monitoring summaries.

items.requirement: Assurance is constrained/suspended when telemetry is incomplete.
items.notes: Document suspension semantics and evidence-quality triggers at a high level.

items.requirement: Execution APIs are policy-bound; catastrophic overwrite prevention exists.
items.notes: Single auditable execution surface with governance authorization gates.

items.requirement: Runtime telemetry supports continuous post-market monitoring.
items.notes: Define monitoring cadence and reporting outputs.

items.requirement: Significant incidents trigger governance review and evidence capture.
items.notes: Incident playbooks are restricted; provide incident category summaries and governance decision logs.

items.requirement: Governance outcomes can be summarized without exposing proprietary internals.
items.notes: Provide scope-bound summaries for regulators.

items.requirement: CSC is not treated as certification; outputs are time- and scope-bound.
items.notes: Include timestamp, scope, and evidence freshness.

items.requirement: Third-party model/API use is declared and governed.
items.notes: Enable when external model APIs are integrated under standards-mediated confirmation.

items.requirement: Evidence is available as summaries/extracts without restricted mechanism disclosure.
items.notes: Maintain an evidence manifest mapping IDs to artifacts, owners, and retention.

operator_signoff.attestation: I attest that this self-assessment reflects current operational evidence availability and that any 'met' items can be supported with evidence artifacts upon request, subject to confidentiality controls.
